title: Drumeo, The 12 Most Iconic Phil Collins Drum Parts
notes: Notation for In the Air Tonight's fill (95 bpm), Nuclear Burn (11/8, eighth = 306), The Cinema Show (7/8, eighth = 238), Supper's Ready (9/8, eighth = 188), Behind the Lines (164), Watcher of the Skies (6/4, 120), Easy Lover's intro. Quotes Collins: 'There's no kick in between the last two tom hits', beside notation that has the kick on the 'e' and the 'a' of 4.
